portal_hypertension.title: Clinical outcomes after TIPS: comparison of patients with a history of partial splenic embolization vs splenectomy in cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhao D, Liu J, Wan J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 240）。核心观点：比较有部分脾栓塞 (PSE) 病史的肝硬化患者经颈静脉肝内门体分流术 (TIPS) 与脾切除术的临床结果，重点关注分流道通畅、明显肝性脑病 (OHE)、再出血和生存情况。 临床提示：比较有部分脾栓塞 (PSE) 病史的肝硬化患者经颈静脉肝内门体分流术 (TIPS) 与脾切除术的临床结果，重点关注分流通畅性、明显的肝栓塞
portal_hypertension.abstract: To compare clinical outcomes of transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) in cirrhotic patients with a history of partial splenic embolization (PSE) vs splenectomy, focusing on shunt patency, overt hepatic encephalopathy (OHE), rebleeding, and survival. This retrospective study included 240 cirrhotic patients undergoing TIPS (TIPS + PSE: n = 126; TIPS + splenectomy: n = 114). After propensity score matching, 88 patients per group were analyzed. The primary endpoint was shunt dysfunction; secondary endpoints included OHE, rebleeding, and survival.
